metaTitle: Custom Over the Ear with Zipper | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom over the ear items with zipper for secure storage. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Over the ear products with zipper closures offer a secure way to store and protect your branded headphones or headsets. The zipper ensures that ear cushions and cords stay safely inside during transport or storage, making these items ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee onboarding kits. Choose from padded cases or pouches in various colors and materials, all customizable with your logo via screen printing or embroidery.
heroAltText: Custom over the ear headphone case with zipper closure and embroidered logo
